definition_used: When a journal/publisher/institution states that a paper came from a paper mill or the paper is in a list of paper mill papers. RW may also use this reason to reflect that RW has identified multiple paper mill criteria applying to this paper.
caution: Paper mill designation is a composite signal; specific underlying problems (data, images, authorship) are not detailed in the definition, so problem_object is set to article_general. Actor_context reflects the typical source of the statement (journal/publisher/institution), not blame.
semantic_rationale: Paper mill involvement implies fabricated or manipulated content (research_content_reliability), likely fraudulent authorship or attribution issues (attribution_authorship_disclosure_integrity), and compromised peer review (editorial_peer_review_governance). The definition focuses on the origin of the paper, not post-publication processes, so post_publication_transparency_due_process_oversight is not directly supported.
